dispositions.topic_text: Named listener operation for HTTP framing and surface dispatch
dispositions.reason: The listener's accept, framing and dispatch are internals of instance_lifecycle behind start_instance (State 3 'Hides': the two listening surfaces); State 6 types them as its internal functions. No caller observes the internal call direction.

dispositions.topic_text: Outcome, response, operation termination, and connection disposal after request-body or upload-head failure
dispositions.what: What a surface does when its reading of a request body fails before it has a request to hand on — a form, a service request, an upload's head: whether it hands the request on without values (admitted, restarting the idle time, refused at stage 1) or closes the connection; sign-in bodies included. Decided in the contracts and notes of serve_owner_request and serve_service_request, consistent with A13 rule 2's 'any request ... whatever its answer'.
